# @saasreport/sdk

Every OpenAPI 3.1 contract of a project → a typed JavaScript client (`index.mjs` + `index.d.ts`), a Node CLI
(`cli.mjs`) and a typed Python client (`python/<name>_sdk`), generated by the kit's native Forge,
[`@saasreport/forge`](../forge/README.md) (no Docker, no vendored bundle), and `kit check sdk`: fails on a contract without
its SDK, a stale or hand-edited SDK (regenerated in memory and compared byte for byte), and a hand-written client that
duplicates it. Compulsory for every project (owner's decision, 2026-10-06). Full text and diagram:
[docs/SDK.md](../../docs/SDK.md).

```sh
kit sdk generate        # kit.sdk.json targets → sdk/<name>/ + forge.manifest.json
kit check sdk           # also part of kit check canon (first step of npm test)
```

```js
import { generateTarget, writeTarget, checkSdk } from "@saasreport/sdk";
```

This package is the kit's policy and bookkeeping (kit.sdk.json, manifests, output directories, the allow list, the
duplicate scan); the generation itself is `@saasreport/forge`'s.
